literal: An ignorant man rejoicing in heart giving is not anything else than the receiver's past merit.
translation: When an ignorant man gives with a glad heart, it is due to nothing other than the past merit of the receiver.
modern: அறிவில்லாதவன் மனமகிழ்ந்து ஒரு கொடையைக் கொடுப்பது, அதனைப் பெறுகின்றவனுடைய தவப்பயனே தவிர வேறு ஒன்றும் இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet explains the rare occurrence of an ignorant person performing an act of charity. Since an unwise person lacks the understanding to give purposefully, any instance where they give with a glad heart is not due to their own virtue. Instead, it is attributed entirely to the good fortune or past spiritual merit of the recipient. The word 'tavam' here refers to the accumulated merit or destiny of the receiver that makes the impossible happen.
